stories.title: Reevaluating 32 bold NFL predictions, five weeks in: Which are on target, and which need a do-over?
stories.summary: In the preseason, we made bold predictions for every NFL team, from Jordan Love's MVP case to Isaiah Likely's catch total. Which ones are on track? Which seem unlikely?

stories.title: Week 6 buzz: What we're hearing on the slumping Eagles, three undefeateds, more
stories.summary: We have intel on Philly's three-game slide, three remaining unbeaten teams, and QBs at risk of being benched.

stories.title: Mattingly gets Phillies' manager job, reaching 2-year deal
stories.summary: Don Mattingly, who guided the Phillies to the playoffs after taking over as interim manager just 28 games into the season, reached a two-year deal to return.

stories.title: Source: Lamar has realistic chance to return for Week 6 game vs. Browns
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has a realistic chance to return for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns, a league source told ESPN.

stories.title: Packers' Parsons on injury return: If Super Bowl was this week 'I'm playing'
stories.summary: The Packers' Micah Parsons explained on his podcast why he's not rushing his return from last season's knee injury.
